publisher: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

required_artifacts.role: publication-era antibody metadata and clinical status labels

binding_rule: All three exact files must be SHA-256 bound in one source manifest before normalization. The confirmatory runner must reference the resulting manifest hashes. Replacement files require a new source manifest and a new prospective run; prior results are not rewritten.
provenance_boundary: These source hashes establish historical dataset identity only. They do not manufacture per-assay wet-lab batch/run provenance that Jain 2017 did not publish.
